correctness.rationale: PASS: For F=e6(x0,...,x6), the singular Jacobian ideal J is generated by its seven degree-five derivatives. Direct coordinate case analysis establishes sqrt(J)=K, the squarefree degree-five monomial ideal defining the 35 triple-zero coordinate P^3 strata. An independently written exact SymPy rational Gröbner calculation recovered a 51-element grevlex basis and Hilbert numerator for S/J, 1-7t^5+6t^7+21t^10-35t^11+14t^12, alongside S/K numerator 1-21t^5+35t^6-15t^7. Exact independent monomial colon recursion and subtraction/cancellation yield Hilb(K/J)=(14t^5+21t^6+21t^7+14t^8)/(1-t)^3 and eventual polynomial 35d^2-350d+903. At generic triple zeros e2 transverse Hessian is nondegenerate, so no nil excess; at four zeros reduction to e3 in four variables gives four linearly independent quadratic derivatives and six pair products in its radical, leaving square-zero excess of length two. Rational Gröbner basis verifies the all-degree quotient, not interpolation of finite values.
